attribution_text: Zooniverse / Panoptes. Lumina uses only bounded public project identity and live-status fields for six reviewed astronomy projects; participation occurs on the external Zooniverse site.
authentication_method: The six reviewed public project endpoints require no Lumina credential or user account. Lumina sends no user identity, location, age, or classification data.
cache_ttl: Fresh for 8 hours after a successful atomic six-project snapshot; stale-if-error for the following 72 hours; expired thereafter.
contact_or_user_agent_requirement: Lumina sends a fixed identifying User-Agent and the Panoptes version-1 vendor Accept header. Requests use HTTPS, six fixed GET paths, no query values, no redirects, and no inherited proxy environment.
failure_and_fallback_behaviour: Fetch the six exact reviewed project IDs in order under one provider lease and request-cycle deadline. Validate every identity before atomically publishing one snapshot. On any failure retain the prior complete snapshot and expose stale data only during the approved stale-if-error interval; expired or missing data is status-unavailable, never fabricated active state.
fetch_time_policy: Each accepted snapshot records one Lumina retrieval time in the generic provider cache. Panoptes updated_at is retained per project as provider source time and is not relabeled as retrieval time.
fixture_and_checksum_strategy: Offline tests use sanitized deterministic fixtures for all six direct project envelopes plus identity drift, private/live state, malformed JSON, duplicate keys, oversized responses, retry, and partial-failure cases. Each exact body is SHA-256 hashed and the ordered bodies receive the LUMINA-PANOPTES-SNAPSHOT-V1 framed aggregate SHA-256.
known_limitations: The provider covers only six exact reviewed astronomy projects and is not a Zooniverse search or discovery API.

Lumina consumes only id, slug, private, live, and updated_at. Provider descriptions, introductions, user/classification counts, Talk content, tags, arbitrary URLs, and community data are deliberately ignored.

A project is presented as currently active only when a non-expired cached exact record is public and live=true. Missing, expired, disabled, or invalid provider state is shown as current status unavailable.
The provider does not authenticate users, submit classifications, create accounts, fetch Talk, or track a user across the external handoff.
observation_or_publication_time_policy: Panoptes updated_at is retained as an explicit source-updated UTC timestamp for each exact project. It is not a classification timestamp, participation timestamp, or Lumina retrieval time.
purpose: Bounded current public/live status for Lumina's six curated astronomy citizen-science project identities.
rate_or_fair_use_constraints: One logical provider lease and one circuit cover the finite six-request plan. Successful synchronization is due every six hours, with the existing framework retry policy, 32768-byte per-component bounds, and a 196608-byte complete raw evidence bound.
refresh_schedule: An external operator scheduler may enqueue provider.sync for zooniverse-panoptes on a six-hour cadence. The Participate page and public API never trigger Panoptes requests.
